create_TikaLoader: create a TikaLoader instance to extract text from files via a Tika server endpoint
create_DoclingLoader: create a DoclingLoader instance to convert documents to markdown via the Docling API
create_Loader_load: create a Loader instance and call load to parse a file into LangChain Document objects
create_Loader_get_loader: create a Loader instance and call _get_loader to select the appropriate document loader by file type
test_Loader_is_text_file: test the Loader._is_text_file method to check if a file extension or content type is recognized as text
